name: Wizard Spider C2 Infrastructure Blocking on AWS
description: Block Wizard Spider Command and Control infrastructure (13.248.169.48, 76.223.54.146, backup.malicious.net) using AWS native security services. These IPs host 10+ malware families including Emotet, Trickbot, and Ryuk ransomware. OTX confirmed malicious activity.

AWS_WAF.description: Create WAF IP set and rule to block C2 IPs
steps: aws wafv2 create-ip-set --name Block-C2-IPs --scope REGIONAL --addresses 13.248.169.48/32 76.223.54.146/32 --ip-address-version IPV4
Create WAF rule using this IP set with action BLOCK
Attach rule to Web ACL for production resources

AWS_Network_Firewall.description: Block outbound traffic to C2 IPs at network perimeter
steps: Create stateful rule group blocking destination IPs 13.248.169.48/32 and 76.223.54.146/32
Attach rule group to firewall policy

AWS_GuardDuty.description: Enable threat detection for C2 communication
steps: Create custom threat list with IPs 13.248.169.48 and 76.223.54.146
aws guardduty create-threat-intel-set --name WizardSpider-C2 --location s3://bucket/blocklist.txt --format TXT
Monitor GuardDuty findings for C2 communication alerts

AWS_Route53_DNS_Firewall.description: Block DNS resolution for C2 domain
steps: Create DNS firewall rule with action BLOCK

AWS_Security_Groups.description: Add explicit deny rules for C2 IPs
steps: Add outbound deny rules for 13.248.169.48/32 in all security groups
Add outbound deny rules for 76.223.54.146/32 in all security groups
Use AWS Config to monitor compliance
Reference OTX enrichment showing 10 malware samples
